hits.about: Millennium Talia Residences at Al Furjan is a unique residential complex for those who are looking for luxurious and cozy apartments in the heart of Dubai. This residential complex offers a wide selection of spacious and stylish 1 and 2 bedroom apartments. Each apartment is equipped with modern appliances, and the renovation is made with high-quality materials.This residential complex offers a wide range of premium amenities that will ensure you a comfortable lifestyle. Round-the-clock security guarantees security, and a concierge is also present.One of the main advantages of Millennium Talia Residences is excellent conditions for rest and relaxation. Residents can use a spacious swimming pool for adults and a cozy pool for children. There is also a playground where they can play and have fun in a safe and protected area.Residents of Millennium Talia Residences have access to a state-of-the-art fitness room. In addition, there are shops in the complex where you can buy everything you need without leaving the building.What makes Millennium Talia Residences truly unique is the premium services provided by Millennium Hotels & Resorts. Residents will be able to enjoy the first-class hospitality and comfort that this company provides to its customers around the world.
hits.title: Millenium Talia Residence
